title: Blade pitch at the end stops
description: Blade pitch variation over the P2 sweep from six linkage tolerances, folded through the sweep's own Jacobian at every point and checked against S461-607 at the -7 and +72 deg stops.

context_ref.callout: The propeller assembly shall provide propeller pitch end stops at -7º and +72º.
context_ref.note: c_status: draft. The stop's target value; the sweep point is the one whose solved blade pitch is nearest it, found by value.

context_ref.callout: The propeller assembly shall provide propeller pitch end stops at -7º and +72º.
context_ref.note: c_status: draft. The stop's target value; the sweep point is the one whose solved blade pitch is nearest it, found by value.

contributors.note: Same physical dimension in both topologies: the pitch link's centre-to-centre length. pitch_system names it plate-hole to arm-hole, vpa_pitch_linkage sphere centre to sphere centre; the two holes are where those sphere centres sit.

pitch_system's arm link-hole-to-clocking-hole position is where the pitch arm puts the link's blade-side joint centre relative to the blade root, which is what vpa_pitch_linkage's pitch_arm_radius edge spans. pitch_system carries it as a tangential tolerance with its own rotary transform; here the same band is read as a position zone of that radius about the joint centre, in every direction, which is the worst-azimuth reading of a positional tolerance. linkage's point_b is the blade body's end: it rotates about CAD X with blade pitch while point_a rides the plate (see provenance).

pitch_system's plate flange-to-link-hole is the axial (spindle-axis, CAD Z) height of the link hole on the pitch plate, which is the height half of vpa_pitch_linkage's spindle-bore-to-link-attach-bore pair (its radius half is pitch_plate_attach_radius, not banded anywhere). So the band perturbs only the plate-side point's Z component. linkage's point_a is the plate body's end (see provenance).

contributors.gap: No band for the tangential link's centre-to-centre length is cited anywhere in this repo: pitch_system does not model the tangential link at all, and vpa_pitch_linkage's own tan_link_length edge carries no dimension (212956-005's drawing has not been read for it).
contributors.note: Its sensitivity is shown so the cost of a band here is visible before one is cited.

Same name, same quantity: the height of the tangential-link mount's bore along the spindle axis (CAD Z). pitch_system measures it from the gas-spring seat to the hub seat, vpa_pitch_linkage from the mount's hub face to its bore; either way it moves the base-side joint centre axially, so the band perturbs only that point's Z component. linkage's tan_link point_a is the base end (see provenance).

contributors.gap: No positional tolerance for the pitch plate's tangential-link attach point is cited anywhere in this repo: vpa_pitch_linkage's pitch_plate_tan_link_attach_radius edge carries no dimension, and pitch_system does not model the tangential link.
contributors.note: A sphere because the attach point's location error has no preferred direction until a drawing says which callout controls it.

checks.label: Blade-pitch variation margin against S461-607, at the -7 deg stop

configuration.sensitivity_condition: the P2 sweep's own Jacobian at the point nearest -7 deg

source_ref.callout: The pitch angle of each blade in a propeller assembly shall not exceed +/-0.5 degrees of the mean pitch of the blades
source_ref.note: c_status: draft. Pulled 2026-09-06 from Polarion (Delta mirror, manufacturing.polarion.workitem); severity must_have. This is a blade-to-blade variation limit, not a limit on this chain's own accumulated position error -- adopted here as the closest available numeric acceptance criterion for the accumulated tolerance this study folds, because S461-241 states only the two nominal stop angles and S461-805's own threshold is TBD (see excluded_terms).

context_ref.callout: The propeller assembly shall provide propeller pitch end stops at -7º and +72º.
context_ref.note: c_status: draft. Pulled 2026-09-06. Names the nominal operating point this study represents (-7 deg); not itself a numeric criterion, so not folded into the check -- carried as the context a reader needs to know WHY this study exists, per SourceRef.kind 'requirement'.

excluded_terms: the end-stop location itself -- where the driver's zero sits is the parallel study the_travel_between_the_end_stops_is_a_study; its total enters here later as a band on actuator.value, whose Jacobian entry is the motion ratio

gas-spring bushing tipping -- a disk on the plate slide's axis components, whose band is a tilt in rad; P2 carries its Jacobian, but neither the bushing's radial clearance nor the bushing length that turns that clearance into a tilt is cited anywhere yet
every geometric callout (position, profile, runout) on the linkage's parts -- none is read into either topology
tan_link_length and pitch_plate_tan_link_attach_radius -- contributors with a sensitivity and no cited band (the gap rows)

S461-805 (Blade Pitch Position Accuracy) states its own threshold as literally 'TBD deg' in Polarion -- draft, no usable numeric criterion, so it supplies no check of its own and is not folded into this one either

provenance.sweep: linkage run P2 (tangential link turns the plate), run_id vpa-pitch-p2-20261016-235852, read from data/inbox/linkage-sweeps/: linkage's republish, the first P2 run to carry geometry.features[], so every contributor's authored feature join is checked against the artifact's own. Re-pointed 2026-10-21 from vpa-pitch-p2-20261015-013931, whose Jacobian, solved blade pitch and driver values are identical to this run's entry for entry. Its sensitivity block states its own analytic-vs-finite-difference agreement (sensitivity.max_finite_difference_disagreement); the projection carries that number beside every result built from it.
provenance.which_end_is_which: The artifact's `mechanism` block names no body per joint end, so the sides were read off the artifact's own motion: at every point pitch_link.point_a_world sits at geometry pitch_link.point_a[2] plus the driver value on CAD Z (it rides the pitch plate's slide) while point_b_world keeps x = 83 and turns about CAD X (the blade's pitch axis). So pitch_link point_a = pitch_plate, point_b = blade. For the tangential link, point_a_world never moves and equals provenance.tangential_link.ends.base.centre_world_mm, and point_b equals ends.plate.centre_world_mm at zero travel: tan_link point_a = base, point_b = pitch_plate. Each contributor's `feature.body` records its side, and the run's own geometry.features[] names the same body for every label a contributor perturbs.
provenance.band_pairings: Each band is borrowed from topology_pitch_system.json by dimension_ref and carries that edge's own source_ref and confidence unchanged; why each pitch_system edge stands for each vpa_pitch_linkage edge is in that contributor's `note`.

notes: Variation only: every band is about a nominal of 0.0, so each point's fold is the deviation of blade pitch from the sweep's own nominal there. The nominal itself is the sweep's solved value, carried beside the fold, never added to it.
complete: false at both stops, so both verdicts render as budgets: two of six contributors are gap rows, and the end stop's own location, bushing tipping and temperature are not contributors yet.
